basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: Manages a media asset and its renditions as technical representations, not the creative work they express.
A filename, URL, storage key or checksum is not the identity of the asset.
A checksum proves fixity of bytes, not authenticity, origin or rights.
A content credential is a provenance signal, not proof of truth or copyright.

may: Extract technical metadata and identify formats.
Create derivative renditions such as proxies or thumbnails.

considerations: Media often depicts people who did not consent to its use.
Synthetic or altered media can mislead audiences.
Accessible renditions such as captions are needed for people with disabilities.

items: A rendition has a media type, size, checksum, technical characteristics and a role in the asset.
Often confused with the creative work, a publication and a storage copy.
Loss of the only preservation copy.
